description: Check whether an email address exists and is safe to send to, before it bounces. Checks the format and the domain's mail servers, then asks the mail provider about the exact mailbox, without sending anything. Returns `verdict`: deliverable, undeliverable, risky (a disposable address) or unknown (the mail server neither confirmed nor rejected the mailbox), with `reason`. Spends 1 credit for the mailbox check; a malformed address or a domain that takes no email is answered free, and an unknown is refunded.

email.description: The email address to verify, e.g. jordan@acme.com.

name: verify_email
title: Verify an email address
